main_text.l: PHARAO, in his, de quibus Biblia, tertius, Iosephi in Ægyptum beneficiorum immemor, Exodi 1.8. Act. 7.18. hic adversus Israel ingeniosus est, Exod. 1. v. 9.10.15.22. Act. 7.19. [Pharaonem quartum in historia sacra,] aggrediuntur Moses & Aaron, Exod. 5.1. blasphemat, v.2. impium se confitetur, 9.27. & 10.16. indurator, 9.v 34.35. & 10. v.1.20.27.8 14. v.4.8.17. eius indurationis finis, Rom. 9.17. 18. fluctibus cum toto exercitu obruitur, Exod. 14.28.
[Pharao in S. historia, quintus, Salomonis Socer, 1 Reg. 3.1. &c.
Pharao, septimus,] cognomine Nechao, Ioachas Iudæ Regem in vincula coniicit, 2 Regum 23.33. in eius locum Eliacim, eius fratrem, Regem constituit, v. 34. 2. Paral. 36. v. 3.4.
[Pharao octavus, cogn. Ephroe, seu Ophra, vel Apryes, qui paulò ante Sedeciam captum & deportatos in Chaldæam Iudæos regnauit, Ierem. 44.30.]
PHARAONIS, id est Regis, & regni Ægyptiaci excidium prædicitur, Ezech. 29. v.2.3. & 31.13.
PHARES (id est ruptura) Iuda ex Thamar filius, nascitur, & re nata nomen fortitur, Gen. 38.29. eius filij, 46.12.1 Paral. 2 5.
Pharetra hominis, Genes. 27.3.1 Paral. 18.7. Esai. 22.6. Ierem. 51.11. Iob 39.26. Psalm. 11.2. Ierem. 5.16. Ezech. 27.11.
PHARISAEVS quidam Christum convivio excipit, Lucæ 36. (1. Diuisus.)

PHARISAEI (à seiungendo dicti, quòd ab aliis affectata vitæ sanctimonia seiuncti essent. Idem testatur & Tertullianus libro de Præscript.) Pharisæi maledicti, Matth. 2 versicul. 13.14.15. Luc. 11.42.43.44. Ioannem Baptistam accedunt, & ab eo grauiter increpantur, Matth. 3.7. Ioan. 1. ver. 19.24. à Christo insciti arguuntur, Matth. 12.2. & in Christum conspirant, & illi insidiantur, Marc. 3.6. & 13. murmurant in Christum, Matth. 9.11. Marc. 2.16. Luc. 30. & 15.2, & in eius Discipulos, Matth. 12.2. & 15.2. Marc. 24. & 7.5. Luc. 6.2. signum postulant, Matt. 12, 38. confiliu Dei spernunt, Lucæ 7.30. Christum tentant, Vide CHRI STVS. Vt Christum capiant, ministros mittunt, Ioann. 32. eorum
